locale.description: BCP-47 locale for weekday names (e.g. 'en-US', 'nl-NL'). Empty = browser/session default. Also selects the built-in UI-text language (see config.labels).

firstDayOfWeek.description: First day column of the week grid.

dayStartHour.description: First hour shown on the week grid's time axis (0-24).

dayEndHour.description: Last hour shown on the week grid's time axis (0-24, > dayStartHour). Availability outside the window is clipped, not lost.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale.

noSelection.description: Detail placeholder when nothing is selected.

alternating.description: Badge: alternating A/B schedule (week A shown).

activeNow.description: Tooltip of the list's active-now dot.

data.description: The schedules to display. Bind 'schedules' to the gateway's schedule list — typically an expression binding with a script transform over system.user.getSchedules() mapping each model to the flat shape below (see the ScheduleDemo view for the reference script).

schedules.description: Array of schedule objects mirroring Ignition's BasicScheduleModel: flat per-day enabled flags + 24h range strings, exactly what system.user.getSchedules() yields and addSchedule/editSchedule accept back. Items stay open — extra fields ride along untouched.

observeHolidays.description: Schedule observes the gateway's holiday list.

repeatAlternating.description: Alternating A/B week schedule. This milestone renders week A only.

mondayTime.description: Monday availability, 24h ranges: '8:00-17:00' or '8:00-12:00, 12:30-17:00'. Blank while enabled = all day.

tuesdayTime.description: Tuesday availability ranges (same format as mondayTime).

state.description: Two-way runtime state: the component writes user interactions back here, and writing a value drives it.

selectedSchedule.description: Name of the selected schedule (two-way): clicking the list writes it back, and setting it selects. When it names no bound schedule, the component selects the first one and writes that back.

output.description: Read-only derived values (the component writes them; do not bind INTO them).
